Meaning of the colours Workawayers needed Possibility that workawayers are needed No availability Close Details Description 🌿 Hi, I’m Ben – from Hanoi 🌿 Hi, this is Ben. Welcome to Vietnam. I enjoy both adventure and stillness. I love sharing stories about Vietnam with people from around the world, and at the same time, learning from them. We’re Hiring Volunteers for Our Countryside YouTube Channel! 🌾🎥 Are you passionate about storytelling, social media growth, and the peaceful charm of rural life? We are looking for enthusiastic volunteers to help us build and grow a YouTube channel dedicated to capturing the authentic daily life, culture, and beauty of our countryside. We are looking for creative minds with skills & experience in: Social Media & YouTube Growth: Experience in building, managing, and growing YouTube channels or social media platforms (optimizing SEO, titles, thumbnails, and engagement strategies). Videography & Photography: Capturing cinematic visuals and authentic everyday moments. Video Editing: Assembling raw footage into engaging, high-quality videos. Storytelling & Scriptwriting: Crafting compelling narratives and video concepts. On-Camera Hosting: Presenting, guiding viewers, and bringing stories to life. If you love nature, rustic living, and digital content creation, we’d love to have you on our team! Types of help and learning opportunities Art Projects Help with Eco Projects Light gardening Creative DIY projects Farmstay help Creating/ Cooking family meals Help around the house Hospitality/Tourism Light maintenance Help with Computers/ Internet Interests Farming Videography Carpentry Nature Outdoor activities Cultural exchange and learning opportunities You will have the occasion to discover the surroundings, mountains, rice fields, go camping, motorcycling, trekking, meet the local people and experience their daily lifestyle. Projects involving children This project could involve children. For more information see our guidelines and tips here . Help At the moment we need help with marketing and content creation for designing a spiritual retreats-healing/ nature adventures that will include: yoga, nature trips, meditation, breath work, sound-healing. Languages Languages spoken English: Fluent Vietnamese: Fluent This host offers a language exchange This host has indicated that they are interested in sharing their own language or learning a new language. You can contact them directly for more information. Accommodation We have wooden houses with both private and dorm rooms. The place is very quieted and secure surrounding with nature and lovely neighbors. Wifi is fast, full facilities such as kitchen and bathrooms. What else ... Important: Im living in Hanoi so I don't stay at the wood house all the time.. so make sure you can work independently and cook for yourself :) You can usually stay from a minimum of one week to several months, or even longer. However, we reserve the right to end your stay immediately — even within the first day — if you engage in illegal activities, use drugs or addictive substances, negatively impact the shared environment, or if your skills do not meet the required standards. To Ben and Kuba - much love and gratitude to you both, thank you for everything, may health, wealth, and abundance in every flavor find us <3 (Excellent ) 28 Sep 2024 Left by Workawayer (Talha) for host Between the Woodhouse, the fellow workawayers, Ben's hosting, the hospitality of the local people, meditation while floating in the pond, early morning Yoga, exploring the forest, skipping rocks, savoring green teas, enjoying food, and just sharing a good laugh every few hours... This was my first ever workaway and I do not think it could HAVE … read more been any better. I was at Ben's Woodhouse for 7 days and the experience was cathartic. Ben is a man who has lived an interesting life and plans to continue doing so. He wants to see, explore, and experience unorthodox, somewhat unusual things in life, and it's easy to see why he decided to build a woodhouse in such a remote location. There’s a river, a couple of caves, comical myths and stories about one of the caves, plenty of different kinds of plants and trees, the lively energy of the local people, the cute and clumsy domestic animals, the crabs, the dragon flies, and of course, you get to live in a Woodhouse surrounded by it all. If, or more like, when I’m ever back in Vietnam, I’d love to come back and see how everything looks in a year or two. One of the wood houses was already mostly done by the time I got there. I contributed by helping clean the place, moving around pieces of wood, making wooden tables for the rooms, sanding and painting the walls, among other stuff. There was no sense of rush. As Ben put it, us, workawayers, are his friends. We’d do some work, have some food, go for a swim if the weather allows it, and just make some progress everyday. It was nice to see the inside of the Woodhouse go from a rather chaotic mess to the kind of place that just about anyone would love to experience as sort of a holiday in the countryside. I could only stay for one week but these 7 days were a nice little break from our fast-paced, capitalist, materialist, world. Thank you Ben for having me at your Woodhouse. Thank you Jakub for the Yoga lessons, the Meditation, and for teaching me many things. Thank you Mika/Niki for taking an active part in my humor, and for the cool Rock, and also thank you for the ART Niki (I’m gonna tell everyone I found it in the Mong King’s cave) Leila arrived the day before I was going to leave and it’s a shame that I couldn’t hear more of your stories from the “Almost 70” Countries you’ve hitchhiked your way through, but I’ll read your Book when it’s ready (Maybe also tell my Grandkids that I met you before you hitchhiked through Pakistan haha) Well I guess that’s it… wait. One more thing... Love y’all for laughing at my stupid jokes! 💀🙏 You can only contact Workawayers who have an active membership. (Excellent) 14 Jan 2020 Left by host for Workawayer ( Dipankar ) This guy is really good at IT and videos maker..thanks budy (Excellent) 7 Dec 2019 Left by Workawayer ( Dipankar ) for host I was in SaPa and then suddenly saw this host and I sent him a last minute request and Ben instantly replied and asked to join the team. Me and another traveller, we both went to his beautiful (read, amazingly beautiful!!) hostel after a few days as we were already on a trek through the beautiful hills and valleys of SaPa. We met neither Ben nor … read more his wife, they were in Hanoi and extremely busy, communication was hard as Ben is working a lot on building another hostel. We cluelessly started on our project of making a promo video and finished it in 4 days. It was a bit challenging as neither of the owners were there to talk or guide on exactly what they need. Nonetheless we discussed a bit with the girls working in the hostel and we made one promo video. You can check it here: https://youtu.be/LbJCmKJMGfQ The hostel is excellent, really beautiful and also the girls working there are so nice and kind. They also cooked delicious food for us. They helped us with arranging motorbike for a motorcycle loop that we did, and they also were kind enough to help us with our bus tickets. We so wished we met this amazing couple of this amazing hostel. Time was short, we wished we could stay longer, but yes, we'll go back to Vietnam again, and may be we see that time!
